say:1:1711127002:1.text: It seems I'll have to figure it out myself... Maybe I can try my luck somewhere else?
say:1:1711127002:1.source_cn: 看来只能自己想办法了……或许，能去别的地方碰碰运气？

say:2:1711127003:1.text: For example, a place known only to the two of you—the Fortified Council Chamber.
say:2:1711127003:1.source_cn: 比如，一个只有你们两个人才知道的地方——坚壁议事厅。
